result.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
result.summary: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. And choosing the decisions is the ground-state problem of a higher-order Boltzmann machine whose interactions follow the paths of the tree, the problem class that annealers and quantum optimizers are built to solve. Today these questions are handled apart: each compression method brings its own format and solver, a circuit with fixed weights needs a dedicated constant multiplier for every weight, and discrete solvers reach only narrow subproblems such as rounding. Weight formats have long been moving toward shared decisions, through group scales, shared exponents, microexponents and sparse weights; TWIG takes this trend to its end, and every common format is a shallow TWIG at no extra cost. On five weight matrices of a large language model, a flat tree whose signed power-of-two terms are chosen per weight for circuit cost, with no group scales, needs 9--15\% fewer additions than GPTQ at equal layer error at 3- and 4-bit accuracy on typical matrices, and 20--55\% fewer on matrices with strong outliers.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TWIG 表示，把网络权重写成共享离散决策（符号、2 的幂位移、零门、共享表索引）构成的树路径，从而统一量化、剪枝、低秩与权重共享，并可映射为固定权重电路、用退火类求解器选择决策；在 LLM 权重矩阵上比较加法开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属于权重格式与压缩/硬件映射工作，虽涉及树状共享离散决策，但不涉及 VLM 推理的 latent 状态生成、视觉证据使用或停止决策，未发现可供核查的迁移线索，故排除。
